opening.argument: The host identifies the computer warnings as false, describing pop-ups that claim a computer is blocked and infected as “basically a lie.” He calls the other participant a pop-up scammer and tells him to stop scamming people. Those are the terms in which the recording presents the purported technical-support interaction: as something being investigated and criticized, not a service the creator offers to viewers. The alert with SUPPORT and PAY buttons, the directions to open a support page and run an executable, and the stated $999.99 charge with a card request are the material under examination. The call includes payment language, but the recording does not establish that the creator offered the service or that any payment occurred.
